title: Priority Credits Ledger and Surge Activation Playbook
creator: Priya Sharma
description: Problem: mid-cycle emergency work and unplanned requests are consuming engineering capacity and causing slippage on committed initiatives. We propose a Priority Credits Ledger (PCL) that assigns a finite pool of credits to initiatives each cycle. Credits are spent to temporarily activate surge lanes (short-term headcount bump, cross-team shadowing, fast-track QA) or to request scope eviction for lower-priority work. The playbook includes allocation rules, approval flows, automated accounting, measurement targets, and a pilot rollout plan. Integration points: Linear (approvals + audit links), Console (capacity dashboards), Cycle Planner UI (ledger view).

acceptance_criteria: Ledger API: create budgets, consume credits, emit auditable links to originating Linear issue
Console view: per-initiative credit balance, recent spend list, 'request surge' flow
Approval flow: auto-approve for spends <= 2 credits; manual approve for >2 credits with notifications
Pilot: run with Growth and Platform for 2 cycles and capture metrics: commit accuracy, urgent-ticket MTTR, team satisfaction
Rollback guardrail: pause if pilot increases slippage or NPS drops by more than 10 points
Legal & Security sign-off for audit retention and KMS handling before broader rollout
